mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (login_id, password, email, name, dept_id, intro, role, account_status, approved) VALUES (#{login_id}, #{password}, #{email}, #{name}, #{dept_id}, #{intro}, 'USER', 'Active', FALSE)
INSERT INTO mentor (member_id, career, cert, field) VALUES (#{member_id}, #{career}, #{cert}, #{field})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mentor WHERE member_id = #{member_id}

SELECT member.member_id, member.login_id, member.name, member.dept_id, member.intro, member.account_status, member.approved, member.profile_public, mentor.field AS mentor_field, mentor.career, mentor.cert FROM member INNER JOIN mentor ON mentor.member_id = member.member_id ORDER BY member.member_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participation WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND project_role = 'MENTOR' AND join_status = 'JOINED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participation p INNER JOIN project pr ON pr.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.project_role = 'MENTOR' AND p.join_status = 'JOINED' AND pr.status != 'DONE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participation WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND project_role = 'MENTOR' AND join_status = 'OFFER'

SELECT pr.project_id, pr.title, pr.category, pr.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participation x WHERE x.project_id = pr.project_id AND x.join_status = 'JOINED' AND x.project_role IN ('LEADER', 'MEMBER')) AS member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.project_id = pr.project_id) AS task_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.project_id = pr.project_id AND t.status = 'APPROVED') AS task_done, (SELECT MIN(m.meet_date) FROM meeting m WHERE m.project_id = pr.project_id AND m.meet_date >= NOW()) AS next_meeting FROM participation p INNER JOIN project pr ON pr.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.project_role = 'MENTOR' AND p.join_status = 'JOINED' ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC
